scope_statement: OCR GCSE English Literature J352, poetry component, 'Conflict' cluster of the OCR Poetry Anthology 'Towards a World Unknown' Version 2 (first teaching September 2022). The cluster contains exactly these fifteen poems: 'Envy' by Mary Lamb; 'Boat Stealing' by William Wordsworth; 'The Destruction of Sennacherib' by Lord Byron; 'Songs for the People' by Frances E. W. Harper; 'There's a Certain Slant of Light' by Emily Dickinson; 'Colonization in Reverse' by Louise Bennett; 'Vergissmeinnicht' by Keith Douglas; 'What Were They Like?' by Denise Levertov; 'Lament' by Gillian Clarke; 'Flag' by John Agard; 'Honour Killing' by Imtiaz Dharker; 'Partition' by Sujata Bhatt; 'Papa-T' by Fred D'Aguiar; 'We Lived Happily during the War' by Ilya Kaminsky; 'Thirteen' by Caleb Femi. Any other poem named as an anthology poem is out of scope, including the five withdrawn in Version 2 ('A Poison Tree' by William Blake; 'The Man He Killed' by Thomas Hardy; 'Anthem for Doomed Youth' by Wilfred Owen; 'Punishment' by Seamus Heaney; 'Phrase Book' by Jo Shapcott) and any poem from another board's anthology.
